title: We are at the Automated Synthesis Forum in Gothenburg, and the conference just kicked off. Find us at our booth.
summary: Read the latest news and updates from ReactWise about AI-driven chemistry and process optimization.
body_markdown:
We are at the Automated Synthesis Forum in Gothenburg, and the conference just kicked off. Find us at our booth.


If you are here and thinking about data-driven reaction optimization, high-throughput experimentation (HTE), and kinetic model development, you're in the right spot.


Our CEO,[Alexander Pomberger](https://www.linkedin.com/in/apomberger/) , and CTO,[Daniel Wigh](https://www.linkedin.com/in/daniel-wigh/) , are here throughout the conference.


We'd be glad to walk through the platform or just talk about data-driven process development.
